text.text_excerpt: My husband and I had a Groupon to use while in NOLA and really enjoyed our meal at The Star Steak and Lobster House. Our waiter was friendly and attentive and I found the atmosphere cozy and romantic. It's a very small restaurant and about half the tables were full when we went on a Tuesday night. There was no live music. My husband and I both started with salads--my husband had the house salad and was a tad disappointed that the dressing option was so scant (only three options) but I was thrilled with my tomato, basil, mozzarella appetizer. I was kind of surprised that there was no "surf and turf" option on the menu. So my husband ordered the porterhouse steak and I ordered the pair of l...

I ate here twice on my trip to NOLA. It was excellent both times. Their BBQ shrimp is very good. Not as spicy as I expected but full of flavor. Messy to eat, but worth it. I didn't really care for their crab cake. I had the surf and turf both times I was there as it was soooo good. An 8 oz filet, 4 fried shimp and a lobster tail. The steak was perfectly cooked both times, the shrimp and cocktail sauce were both good. The lobster tail was great, but over done like most places. Succulent and tender. I thought it was a hidden gem.

Just a really great dinning experience from the food to the service, and even better because it's away from the Bourbon St craziness and "real." My most recent visit to Nola & Star Steak & Lobster was during Super Bowl week. Was out most of the day and craving a nice sit-down casual dinner as a calming end of the day meal. Had an amazing lobster dinner, great attentive service that perfectly hit the spot. I'd eaten at the restaurant in 2011 when visiting and everything was similarly enjoyable. In particular, kudos to my server (I cant remember his name but I believe he's been there awhile as he looked familiar from 2011).
